notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.Cradle of the Sun.
description:
Activate Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun's second ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Bestial Bloodline, untapping Itlimoc.
Activate Bestial Bloodline by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If you control at least six creatures, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may untap any other permanent(s) using Mind over Matter.
